messages:
Maria G: Heads up — found a KMS grant that allowed the build-agent service account to decrypt a CI artifact bucket backup. Not yet public but logs captured SOME wrapped ciphertext metadata.
Ashwin: yikes. where in infra? staging or prod?
Maria G: prod, tied to old agent role 'build-agent-runner-v1' — looks like an unintended grant from a 2022 onboarding script.
Tia: assigning priority: P1 containment. 
sec-oncall: Agreed. Immediate steps: 1) revoke the KMS grant, 2) rotate the agent key, 3) kick an audit export of decrypt calls, 4) determine blast radius. I'll patch the runbook.
Maria G: I've already filed a temporary deny using gcloud: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/infra/locations/global/keyRING/key --member=serviceAccount:svc-build@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` (then removed). FYI the binding ID was `grant-2022-agent`.
Robin: Did you revoke the binding or delete it? we should revoke first then collect logs.
Maria G: revoked (removed binding) and captured the policy diff.
sec-oncall: Good. Next — rotation plan for agent creds: we'll create a new short-lived service account key with limited grant and rotate consumers within 30m windows. Ashwin, coordinate CI update.
Ashwin: on it. updating ci-runner image tag to use `runner:v20260322-rotation` and pointing to new service account using Workload Identity. I'll push a canary to 5% first.
Tia: Also need to update Vault role that issues wrapped keys to the agent. Current Vault role `ci/agent-decrypt` had an allowed_kms_grants list referencing the old key. We must rebind to the new key and issue new tokens.
Maria G: I'll add a note to the vault change: `vault write auth/kubernetes/role/ci-agent bound_service_account_names=ci-agent bound_service_account_namespaces=ci` and rotate.
Robin: Important: enable KMS key access audit sink for the keyring so we can track any future grants. If possible, forward decrypt logs to long-term audit GCS.
sec-oncall: Agreed. Added audit export task: `gcloud logging sinks create kms-decrypt-audit gs://sec-audit-archive --log-filter='resource.type=\"kms_crypto_key\" AND protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\"'`
Maria G: Quick question on RBAC: should we change the agent role to a principal-of-least-privilege that only allows CryptoKeyVersions.AccessAsymmetricDecrypt? or keep standard decrypter?
Tia: Use the narrowest scope that still supports our workflows. For now switch to `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on a specific key, not keyring, and migrate to asymmetric keys for agent signing where feasible.
Ashwin: CI update pushed. Canary looks stable. No decrypt errors in canary logs.
Robin: Good. Next: credential leakage cleanup checklist — items we did: revoked grant, rotated SA key, issued new Vault role tokens, updated CI canary, enabled audit sink. Remaining: scan for artifacts and backups that used old decrypts. Maria, can you run the S3/GCS object list query for decrypt metadata?
Maria G: Running: `gsutil ls -r gs://backups-prod/** | xargs -n1 -I{} gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=keyRING --key=key --ciphertext-file={} --plaintext-file=-` (dry-run mode — not actually decrypting). Filtering hits for matching ciphertext headers now.
sec-oncall: Also trigger a vulnerability triage: are any partner tokens or third-party webhooks using that agent SA? If yes, rotate those integrations.
Tia: A quick grep across config store shows 3 helm charts referencing `build-agent-runner-v1` — I'll open PRs to update values, mark as emergency deploy.
Ashwin: Noted. Rolling patch scheduled in 20m. Will patch rollout-surge 0 -> minimize blast radius.
rotor-bot: Reminder: run `sec/rotate-agent-keys` playbook after SA key rotation. See runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rotate-agent-keys
Maria G: After rotation complete, we should run an eval on Redwood Optimize suggestions — the quantization/secret caching layer had several entries referencing old agent scope. Need to ensure no cached secrets remain accessible.
sec-oncall: Final ask: document the timeline and decisions in the incident tracker and file an RCA if we confirm any exfil. For now escalate to SecOps lead only if scan finds ciphertext that was copied externally.
Robin: Copy — will prepare incident stub.
Maria G: I'll post results of the artifact scan in this thread in ~40m.
Tia: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maria G: update: scan found two archived blobs with matching header metadata. Initiating content recovery and quarantine. Will attach hash list once recovered.
sec-oncall: Good catch — keep me posted.
